archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / NORDIC INDUSTRIAL PRECISION
theme: Dark High-Contrast Field Tactical Mode with Clean Danish Industrial Aesthetics

worker_screen.viewport: 100dvh full-screen mobile app layout (no outer scrollbars, sticky high-action triggers)
worker_screen.container_class: flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[100dvh] max-w-md mx-auto p-6 bg-[#0B0F19] text-[#F9FAFB] relative overflow-hidden

admin_dashboard.container_class: min-h-screen bg-[#090D16] text-[#F9FAFB] flex flex-col md:flex-row font-sans
admin_dashboard.left_sidebar: w-full md:w-80 lg:w-96 bg-[#0F172A] border-r border-[#1E293B] flex flex-col justify-between shrink-0 p-5
admin_dashboard.center_main_panel: flex-1 flex flex-col p-6 space-y-8 overflow-y-auto bg-[#0B0F19]
admin_dashboard.bottom_table_section: bg-[#111827] border border-[#1F2937] rounded-xl p-6 shadow-2xl

login_state.title: QAKK Worker Login
login_state.description: Minimalist, high-tactile mobile login with large input fields and full-width login button.
elements: App Title & Danish Subtitle: QAKK Tidsregistrering
Email field with auto-capitalization disabled (data-testid='worker-login-email-input')
Password field with toggle visibility (data-testid='worker-login-password-input')
Language selector (EN / DA pill toggle)
Huge login CTA button: 'Indlogning / Login' (data-testid='worker-login-submit-button')

offline_main_state.title: Worker Screen - Offline (Ready to Check-In)
elements: Header: Greeting 'Hi, Kasper / Hej, Kasper', status badge 'Offline / Inaktiv' with grey indicator dot, and EN/DA toggle button (data-testid='worker-lang-toggle')
Inputs Section: Event Name ('Begivenhed / Event') and Client Name ('Kunde / Client') text inputs with quick-suggestion pills (data-testid='worker-event-input', data-testid='worker-client-input')
GPS Status Indicator: '📍 GPS Active: Nyhavn 17, København (Accurate to 8m)'
Check-In Action: Massive Green Ergonomic Check-In Button (data-testid='worker-checkin-button') with press animation and high-visibility text 'CHECK IN / STAMP IND'

online_main_state.title: Worker Screen - Online (Active Work Session)
elements: Inputs DISAPPEAR to prevent accidental edits during physical work
Active Work Panel (data-testid='worker-active-shift-panel'): Live Elapsed Time Counter (HH:MM:SS), 'Current Event: [Event]', 'Client: [Client]', 'Started at: [exact Danish time e.g., 08:15 CET]'
GPS Verification Badge with live pulsating green location dot
Check-Out Action: Massive Red Check-Out Button (data-testid='worker-checkout-button') with text 'CHECK OUT / STAMP UD' and secondary quick notes input before checkout confirm modal

sidebar_live_team_status.title: Live Team Status (Messenger-style real-time feed)
elements: Header: 'Holdstatus / Team Status' with active count summary e.g. '4/8 Online'
Employee List with realtime status indicators: Green dot (Online) vs Grey dot (Offline)
Worker details: Name, current location or 'Logged off', elapsed working time
Inline Action: Red 'Force Check-out' button (data-testid='admin-force-checkout-btn-{workerId}') next to online employees to terminate forgotten sessions

center_active_locations.title: Active Locations (Smart Cards Grouped by Street)
elements: Street Group Header Card e.g. '📍 Nyhavn 17, København K' with active worker count badge e.g. '3 Workers Active'
Inside Card: List of checked-in workers at that location, showing Client Name, Event Name, Check-in Time, and calculated live shift length
Location Mismatch Alert Badge if worker GPS is > 200m away from scheduled venue address

bottom_recent_shifts.title: Recent Shifts & Overrides Table (24th Settlement Queue)
elements: Table Columns: Worker, Location, Check-In, Check-Out, Raw Minutes, 4-Hour Rule Calculated Hours, Status, Actions
Highlight Banner for 4-Hour Rule: '4-hour guarantee applied (Worked <4h credited as 4h00m)'
Action Button: '[Edit Hours / Rediger Timer]' (data-testid='admin-edit-hours-btn-{shiftId}') opening an override modal allowing the boss to manually adjust credit hours with audit log reason
Monthly Payroll Export Indicator: 'Next automated Danish payroll report: 24th at 11:00 CET'

business_logic.four_hour_guarantee_rule: If raw worked time is < 4 hours (240 minutes), the calculated hours automatically credit 4.00 hours. If raw worked time is >= 4 hours, calculated hours reflect exact worked duration.
business_logic.location_mismatch_alerts: If GPS coordinates at check-in deviate significantly from client site geofence, highlight row with Amber warning badge 'Location Mismatch'.
business_logic.twenty_four_hour_forgotten_checkout: If shift exceeds 24 hours without checkout, flag shift with 'Forgotten Checkout' alert and auto-notify admin sidebar with Force Check-out pulse.
business_logic.monthly_payroll_schedule: Automated payroll calculation and CSV/PDF export scheduled for 24th of each month at 11:00 Danish Time (CET/CEST).
business_logic.bilingual_support: Single-button toggle switching all labels, buttons, dynamic dates, and status messages between English (EN) and Danish (DA).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dual-view structure: WORKER SCREEN (Mobile 100dvh experience) and ADMIN DASHBOARD (Desktop/Tablet panel view).
Provide a smooth switcher or role selector at the top navigation or demo header to easily test both WORKER SCREEN (as worker 'Kasper') and ADMIN DASHBOARD (as Manager).
Implement language state management (EN / DA) globally using context or state, so toggling language on any screen instantly updates all strings across worker and admin interfaces.
Ensure all interactive elements carry their corresponding `data-testid` attributes as specified in the wireframes section.
Store check-in and shift data in local storage / backend state so that checking in on the Worker screen immediately updates the Live Team Status sidebar and Active Locations cards in the Admin view.
Enforce the 4-hour minimum credit rule calculation in the shifts table.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) with explicit border-white/10.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always specify explicit properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
You MUST NOT center align the main app body text or disrupt the natural reading flow.
Always use high-visibility tactile button styles (pills or sharp industrial rounded borders with active press scale transforms).
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for system icons. Use Lucide SVG icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, button active states, glowing online indicators.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes.
